notes: According to Tracks of Time, George & Pauline came to Waldersee in 1897 and took NW 3-19-12 as their homestead.  All children except Elizabeth were born on the homestead.  All were members of Waldersee Lutheran Church. This family left Waldersee in 1926 and moved to Dugald, MB.
